text:
Nate G: Scheduling a controlled v2 flip for shard C tonight 22:00 UTC. Plan: 5m internal canary -> 10% for 20m -> 40% -> 100% over 90m. Fallback to v1 kept on for 120m.
Priya V: Quick heads up: I found a release-notes mismatch where the SDK compat section omits the header normalization note. Product please confirm.
product-releases: Oops, saw that. Pushing a one-line add for older SDKs (<=1.9.0) recommending `x-api-compat: v1`. Updating draft now.
Lina M: Added a temporary gateway header gate: requests lacking `x-client-version` will be routed to v1 for first 30m. Patch pushed to `gateway/shard-c/header-gate` and tested.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by Nate G for 2026-03-21T22:00:00Z to cluster us-central1. Steps: canary -> gradual-shift -> verify -> finalize. Auto-rollback: error_rate > 4% over 5m OR elevation in 5xx by +2% absolute.
ops-watch: I'll be monitoring 21:45-23:30 UTC. Added `v2.gateway.422_rate.shard_c` and `v2.gateway.4xx_by_tenant` to the watchgroup.
Priya V: Decision: hold on full 40% until release notes live. If any tenant pings support asking about schema errors, pause immediately.
Nate G: Agreed. Can we add a short-lived canary header (`x-cutover-test`) for 10 internal keys?
Lina M: Done. deploy-bot applied canary at 21:50 UTC to 10 keys.
deploy-bot: Canary applied. Observed: 0 errors, latency baseline within 5ms.
ops-watch: Canary looks clean. But product-releases hasn't finalized notes, recommend waiting 10m.
product-releases: Notes updated and linked in the ticket. Added troubleshooting snippet for header case and the compat flag.
Priya V: Good. Ramp to 10% at 22:00 UTC still OK. If 4xx for `route=~"/v2/.*"` > 12 reqs/min for any instance, flip fallback. Flip command (ops VPN only): `POST /admin/route/shard_c/fallback?action=enable`.
Nate G: Logging the operator checklist in the deploy ticket and tagging `#shardC-v2-cutover`. Ops will call if we need to pause.
Lina M: I'll prepare a quick rollback playbook snippet in the ticket: steps, rollback command, and how to revoke the header gate.
Priya V: Thanks. If anything odd, ping me and product-releases.
Nate G: Thanks team, proceeding on the timeline.
